brief.t: First, reply to Oussama Salmi’s new afghani oil haircare inquiry from 3:38 A M. Keep it short and human. Qualify the product, formula path, service needed, target quantity and timing. Do not ask budget in the first reply.

Next, answer Anfal Mohammed in Shopify. He has repeatedly asked for serum or cream per-unit pricing above and below one hundred units. Give only verified pricing and clarify the exact product, size and quantity before quoting.

Have Aidan call Jonathan at Ethnic Gals now. Get the warehouse to count the brand’s purchased ingredients and send Jonathan a written inventory and pickup status today. He tried calling after asking for the inventory spec sheet.
Be ready for the Kenna meeting at eleven A M Eastern. Before it starts, get Aidan’s overdue Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing status and leave the meeting with a named owner and deadline.
Launch James Bailey’s paid production handoff: one thousand twelve-ounce Menthol Infused Shampoo units. Assign and confirm the branded marketing sample bottle, including its ship date.

Clear customer delivery blockers: Laura must give Nadia at Oreka the cream-jar update and review the Canadian label changes; she must also return Drake’s 200 milliliter jar sourcing options for five hundred and one thousand units.

Then close the operating risks: run overdue Gusto payroll, decide Coast Southwest P O twenty twenty six dash zero zero zero four payment or send the hold reason, and restore Ronald’s CRM access so Victor’s overdue costs can move. No CRM developer fix is confirmed.

kb.a: Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, N D A signed. Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, six ounce jar, two thousand units each. Quote overdue since July tenth, still blocked on Ronald's raw ingredient cost per unit, plus packaging and fill labor. Margin was set at seventy five percent but Sam needs to confirm whether that is Victor only or the new P L L standard versus the usual sixty five.

The ConvertFlow lead capture webhook is fixed and live as of July sixteenth. The old webhook was set to the wrong trigger and never fired. Leads now flow to the agent and are being routed into Sam's Outlook so the Email Agent works them. First real lead is Hariett at H B I Salon dot com, a custom hair loss shampoo, masque and serum, five hundred to a thousand units. There are also about a hundred and five contacts sitting in ConvertFlow uncontacted, awaiting Sam's go ahead to sort real buyers from junk.

Shopify order fourteen forty five from Sherman Howard Junior is a zero dollar warranty replacement, two beard shampoos with damaged labels and one beard oil replacing a broken one. Quick customer care item, just needs fulfillment confirmed.

The ISO twenty two seven sixteen G M P certification project was signed on July sixteenth at fourteen thousand seven hundred dollars. Aidan negotiated and closed it. This puts the G M P certification path officially in motion for the new facility.

Raul Guardado sent STRUCK box art revisions: the bottle size should be corrected to twenty milliliters, remove the ounces data as redundant, and add the Made in USA flag clipart that is on the bottle. Routed to Laura. Agent is confirming she is on it.

Elmar Nasibov, three product pricing: Hydrating Mist, Peptide Cream, and Hydrating Serum. Ronald's raw ingredient costs are in but packaging, labor and overhead are still needed to compute the all in price and confirm margin. Reply goes out by WhatsApp once complete.

Elior dry shampoo quote for five hundred and a thousand units. CRM task created, high priority. Still need from Sam: aerosol or non aerosol, Ronald's B O M, packaging type, and margin at sixty five or seventy five. Aerosol matters because it triggers H occupancy and mandatory sprinklers at the new facility.

Ben Kar of Tavro, ninety percent close, about thirty thousand units of custom tallow and argan oil. Proposal has still never been sent. Agent drafts, Sam reviews, then it fires once by WhatsApp and email.

Nadia Dupuis at Oreka Skincare previously accepted quote Q-0007. On July 16 she sent a PDF of proposed Canadian label changes and asked for review; Laura replied she is working on the cream jar, and Nadia thanked her. Today Laura must return the cream-jar update and review the label changes. Do not treat label compliance as approved without qualified review.

Ronald owes several answers: Aran Beauty scent samples in Vanilla, Jasmine, Rose and Sweet Orange, plus raw ingredient costs for Victor and Elior. Agent is ready to nudge him via Team Chat on Sam's go ahead.

Aidan's Kenna Pure Good and Terra Lotus pricing was due July 8 and remains overdue in the CRM. A Kenna meeting is scheduled for July 20 at 11 AM Eastern; obtain Aidan's status before it and leave with a named owner and deadline.

Standing data problem: quotes in the CRM carry raw ingredient cost only. Packaging, fill labor and overhead rates must be added before any quote is trustworthy. Ronald's B O M numbers are ingredients only and must never be quoted as is.
Raanan Rosenbaum of Raanan Media booked a thirty minute call with Sam for nine thirty A M Eastern on Thursday July twenty third.

Previous briefing said the Email Agent had reached its daily credit limit and Ashley at Inspiring Hair needed a response. Capacity and Ashley-contact status are not independently verified in this morning's evidence. New Shopify leads Oussama Salmi and Anfal Mohammed require a prompt owner response regardless.

James Bailey paid a $5,681, 65 percent Shopify deposit for 1,000 twelve-ounce Menthol Infused Shampoo units, total project value $8,740. He requested a logo-branded bottle for marketing. No completed production handoff or sample shipment is confirmed; assign it and confirm a ship date.

Gusto required payroll to be run by Friday, July seventeenth, for the June twenty-ninth through July twelfth pay period, with payday July seventeenth. The deadline was missed and needs immediate CEO action to prevent employee pay delay or penalties. A separate Michigan unemployment insurance ticket, number four three three one nine five seven three, is open with the CPA and is not the payroll run.

Lease Amendment number one for 24600 North Industrial Drive was signed and returned to the landlord at 4:59 P M on July seventeenth; it is complete and not an open task. Michigan Office Movers paperwork has arrived for review and signature, with a two thousand seven hundred fifty dollar deposit required. The move date had been pushed to the twenty-eighth.

Coast Southwest proforma invoice P O twenty twenty six dash zero zero zero four remains unpaid. Jessica Gutierrez says the raw-material order will ship upon receipt of funds; it is holding up production. No new email movement was found, so Sam needs to release payment or provide a hold reason.

Ronald was locked out of the PLL CRM, blocking entry of BOM and ingredient costs for Victor Armendarez and Elior. There is no confirmation that access was restored. Reset access, then direct him to enter Victor's raw ingredient costs; Victor is 87 percent close and overdue since July 10.
The Ads Agent is nearing its daily credit limit. Protect or adjust its capacity after the Email Agent is restored; do not let acquisition work stop unexpectedly.
No CRM UPDATE REQUEST or CRM developer reply was found after July 17. There is no ready-for-verification fix or API reply. Do not mark CRM work complete or make CRM changes based on an assumed fix.

Desiree Moore at Hawke Media has checked in twice for an Ephix kickoff status and timeline. No new email movement was found. Provide a one-line status so a reply can go out before the account cools further.

A new unread Shopify contact-form lead arrived July 20 at 3:38 AM: Oussama Salmi, brand afghani oil, haircare, email osalmi890@gmail.com and phone +1 707 731 6379. The visible body truncates the service-needed field. Respond promptly and qualify product, service, quantity, timing and budget rather than assuming the incomplete details.

Anfal Mohammed sent repeated Shopify Inbox questions on July 19 seeking serum or cream per-unit cost, including for above and below 100 units. Reply in Shopify using only verified pricing; first confirm product, size and quantity. Do not quote an invented unit price.

Jonathan Caesar at Ethnic Gals asked July 13 for an inventory spec sheet and the amount of purchased ingredients available for pickup. Warehouse count was promised. On July 15 Aidan asked Jonathan to call; Jonathan replied that he tried calling. Aidan should call now and warehouse should send a written count and pickup status today.

For True Revival, client revised to a 200 mL (6.8 oz declared contents) dark-green, light-blocking, shower-safe jar with gold branding. Drake accepts 500 or 1,000 jar MOQ. Laura reported stateside custom jars may require 5,000 MOQ and is sourcing alternatives; return options including stock jars with domestic decoration or lower-MOQ custom sourcing.
